items.prompt: Q=1000000000 and 100000 input weights satisfy the practice bounds. Which route matches the lesson?

options.text: Call the old largest_remainder API and ignore its rejection.
options.why: Its intentionally tighter validation is part of that helper's contract.

options.text: Change only the old API label while keeping its checks.
options.why: A new label does not make its tighter accepted domain match the task.

options.text: Split the order into arbitrary independent smaller orders.
options.why: Separate rounding/tie decisions can change the required single-order allocation.

options.text: Use the separate prevalidated slice_order adaptation.
options.why: It implements the larger public task without silently weakening the original helper.

items.explanation: It implements the larger public task without silently weakening the original helper.
